blocks.title: Pauli ka exclusion principle
blocks.text: Atom mein koi do electrons chaaron quantum numbers ki ek jaisi qeematein nahi rakh sakte; ya, ek orbital ke do electrons ke spin hamesha ulte honge.

Helium atom ke pehle shell mein do electrons hain, dono 1s orbital mein. Quantum numbers ke tasawwur aur Pauli ke principle se un ke quantum numbers table wale hain: wahi n, l aur m, magar s ki mukhtalif qeematein, to un ke spin ulti simton mein hain.

blocks.caption: Ek orbital ke do electrons ke quantum numbers (print ki Table 2.6)

blocks.prompt: Kya teesra electron helium ke 1s orbital mein dakhil ho sakta hai? Principle se jawab dein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. 1s mein koi bhi teesra electron n = 1, l = 0 aur m = 0 rakhega, aur us ka spin +1/2 ya -1/2 hona hoga, jo pehle se maujood do electrons mein se kisi ek ke chaaron quantum numbers dohrayega. Principle is se mana karta hai, to orbital do se bhar jata hai.

items: Pauli: atom mein koi do electrons chaaron quantum numbers nahi baantte, to orbital zyada se zyada do electrons rakhta hai, ulte spins ke saath (helium ka 1s jora sirf s mein mukhtalif hai).
